answer: Sybil cost: 500 jade tokens bonded per identity, locked for 10 epochs. 1,000 clones means 500,000 tokens idle before earning anything, and slashing eats the bond on first fraud. New agents start on the lowest terrace, earning only cheap tasks until clean-work epochs accrue; fraud drops them into a canyon of lost stake and reputation. Capital required scales linearly with clone count, so every fake ID raises attack cost.
